title: Environmental Protection Method Statement
description: Free Environmental Protection Method Statement template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers facility information, 3.0 waste management plan, 4.0 discharge permit requirements.

Facility Information

OPERATION TYPE: ☐ Drilling ☐ Production ☐ Well Test ☐ Construction

1.0 SCOPE: This procedure ensures all operations comply with environmental regulations and minimize impact.

2.0 APPLICABLE REGULATIONS:

• MARPOL 73/78 (Annex I-V) • EPA Regulations (40 CFR)

• OPA 90 (Oil Pollution Act) • Local/ National Regulations

• Discharge Permits (NPDES/ equivalent) • Waste Management Regulations

5.3 Spill Response Procedure:

MINOR SPILL (< _____ bbl):

1. Stop source if safe

2. Contain using spill kit materials

3. Notify supervisor

4. Clean up and dispose as hazardous waste

5. Document in spill log

MAJOR SPILL (≥ _____ bbl):

1. Stop source if safe

2. Sound alarm and notify IM

3. Activate emergency response plan

4. Deploy containment booms

5. Notify authorities (within required time)

6. Mobilize spill response team

7. Initiate cleanup

8. Complete full investigation and report
